renee_ml: Heads-up: starting a cautious canary for rwd-v4a-int4. Shadow run last night showed tiny rank drift on codegen and a bump in hallucinations for long technical docs. Want to try a sentinel-adaptive throttle approach instead of flat percent-only rollout.

 tom_prod: Outline the sentinel idea?

 renee_ml: Plan summary: promote to 2% overall but dynamically throttle slices based on sentinel error signals. Use a Bayesian early-stop test for MRR with ESS (effective sample size) requirement, plus a separate hallucination sentinel for longdocs. If bayes P(delta < -0.01) > 0.95 -> rollback. For hallucination, if sentinel longdoc halluc > baseline +1.5pp and trending up over two windows -> throttle longdoc to 0% and hold global rollout.

 isha_research: Stats from shadow:
```
baseline v4a-b (n=24k): MRR=0.429, code_slice_mrr=0.455, longdoc_hall=1.8%
shadow v4a-int4 (n=6k): MRR=0.425, code_slice_mrr=0.443, longdoc_hall=3.1%
delta MRR = -0.4ppt (~-0.93%), code delta -1.2ppt, longdoc hall +1.3pp
```

 pat_infra: How will the adaptive throttle look in config?

 renee_ml: Draft config:
```
rollout: {start:2%, targets:[2%,10%,30%], holds:[45m,90m,180m]}
stat_test: bayesian
bayes_rules:
  metric: mrr
  delta_threshold: -0.01
  prob_rollback: 0.95
  ess_min: 400
sentinels:
  - name: longdoc_hall
    min_samples_per_window: 150
    hall_threshold_pp: 1.5
    trend_windows: 2
    action: throttle_slice_to_zero
  - name: code_mrr
    min_samples_per_window: 100
    mrr_drop_pp: 1.0
    action: reduce_slice_share_to_10pct
adaptive_backoff:
  mode: geometric
  factor: 0.5
  min_share: 0.1
auto_actions: {on_bayes_rollback: immediate_rollback, on_throttle: hold_global}
manual_override: SRE_pause
```
Note: ESS min is to avoid acting on tiny n in 2% start.

 tom_prod: I like the geometric backoff vs hard cut. For code slice we should cap reduction frequency to once per 30m to avoid oscillation.

 pat_infra: I'll enforce slice-rate-limiter with cooldown. Also will emit per-slice telemetry: sample count, failure_count, bayes_p.

 sam_sre: Paging policy: if longdoc hall > baseline +3.0pp OR p999 latency +500ms then page oncall. For non-paging but serious signals we'll create an incident-notify channel.

 isha_research: One more: add a 'noisy-slice dampener' where if a single slice contributes >40% of observed delta and its sample fraction <10% we treat it as high-leverage and require manual review instead of auto-rollback. Avoid false positives from tiny slices.

 renee_ml: Good call. Also we should log the posterior distribution snapshots for offline audit (save posterior mean, 90% credible interval, ESS).

 pat_infra: I'll provision dashboards and wire the bayes posterior metrics. I will also add an event stream so experiments log decisions (throttle/rollback) for audit.

 tom_prod: Can we shadow a small synthetic traffic mix for another 12h in parallel to canary? If we see divergence we abort.

 renee_ml: Yes, schedule synthetic shadow for next 12h. If posterior drift exceeds 0.02 MRR in synthetic traffic -> auto-abort.

 rollout-bot: rollout.start: canary rwd-v4a-int4 @ 2026-03-22T09:12:14Z (2%)

 sam_sre: I'll prepare runbook: steps to manually pause, slice-cut commands, and rollback commands. Add step to run offline longdoc rerank eval with focused prompts.

 isha_research: We'll also run a small post-collection significance report at each hold window. PDF summary + key plots.

 renee_ml: Thanks all. Pushing config to canary policy with adaptive throttle + bayes early-stop. Ping me if dashboards show anything odd. :rocket:

 pat_infra: Done — metrics publishing + cooldown rules in place. Monitoring window open.
